component.name: Vencord Forge
component.summary: Install Vencord into Discord with the plugins you pick

description.p: Vencord Forge builds the Vencord client mod for Discord with exactly the custom plugins and patches you choose, and installs it into the Discord you pick.

ul.li: Finds Discord Stable, PTB, Canary and Development, native or Flatpak
Turn custom plugins and optional patches on or off; the choice is kept across updates
Optionally installs OpenAsar, a faster replacement for Discord's startup code
Every change is verified and rolled back on failure, and one click restores stock Discord

description.p: Not affiliated with Discord, Vencord or OpenAsar. Client modifications are against Discord's Terms of Service.

screenshot.caption: Turn custom plugins on or off

ul.li: The Flatpak no longer needs access to ~/.config/Vencord: the runtime and the saved selection are written by Forge's helper on the host.
A failed install restores the previous runtime in every packaging, including Flatpak.
The host helper also starts on ARM (aarch64) systems.
Add a Themes step with the repatched CreArts v3 (MIT); themes already loaded from QuickCSS are not added twice.
Redesign the install page: overview cards in rows, hold-to-install in the footer, a build log that fills the window and keeps the progress bar in view.
Report an internal error instead of hanging when the install thread fails.
Check whether Discord runs at most every 3 seconds instead of on every frame.
Build with full LTO: 20% smaller binaries.
First release of Vencord Forge for Linux (AppImage, binary, Flatpak) and Windows (.exe).
Pick the Discord installation, custom plugins, patches and OpenAsar; build and install with verification and rollback.
Runs inside Flatpak, changing Discord's files through a helper on the host.
